images.curation_note: Every one of the 16 downloaded photos was viewed individually (not just by filename) before deciding. Discarded from all use: bk-2.jpg (native resolution only 150x150, too low quality), bk-3.jpg (screenshot with visible phone status bar/app UI chrome and a 'Korean Lash Lift Tutorial' video caption baked into the image, prohibited per gallery curation rules), bk-16.jpg (mid-procedure POV shot of the artist's gloved hand actively working, prohibited in gallery), bk-17.jpg (a generic Instagram-marketing stock/promo graphic of unrelated people, clearly not a real photo of this business, returned erroneously by the IG photo service; deleted entirely, never used anywhere). bk-6.jpg, bk-8.jpg, bk-10.jpg and bk-14.jpg were viewed and judged acceptable-but-redundant against stronger alternatives already selected, so were left unused and removed from assets/raw to keep the delivered folder to only the photos actually referenced by index.html.

brand_vibe: No standalone brand logo file was recoverable (Booksy has no logo asset for this venue; the one photo showing any wordmark, bk-8.jpg, has only a small corner watermark baked into a client photo and was not treated as a usable/extractable logo asset). Photos show a warm rosewood/mauve, soft-glam PMU aesthetic (blush tones, warm skin lighting). A dedicated rosewood/dusty-mauve palette was designed to match that mood rather than reusing any already-used DESIGN.md palette. Nav/footer/experience 'logo' spots use a plain CSS text monogram ('ML' in a circle, styled like the template's existing .pre-mono preloader monogram) instead of any photo, since no real business logo exists and using a client's photo as if it were the owner's portrait would misattribute identity.
base_template: templates/light-v2 (light base, lashbloom exemplar, EN default) -- chosen per task instructions as thematically closest (lash/brow/PMU studio)

palette.derivation: Rosewood/dusty-mauve palette, custom-designed to match the warm blush/skin tones visible across the real Booksy gallery photos. Distinct from all palettes already listed as used in DESIGN.md/SKELETONS-V2.md (mizu, amani, mare, alea, pausa, coral fairy, caramelo, esmeralda, teal acero, violeta dark, rosa dark, gold dark).

build_method: Anchored transformation script (Python, rep()/assert-before-replace) over templates/light-v2/index.html per templates/SKELETONS-V2.md, run as 3 sequential scripts (scripts/build_mlesthetics.py: badge protect, palette hex+rgba, globals, head/JSON-LD, preloader, nav, hero, strip, marquee, experience, method; scripts/build_mlesthetics_2.py: 4 destacado service cards + full categorized 41-item menu, no accordions; scripts/build_mlesthetics_3.py: gallery, reviews, location+hours block, CTA, footer, book-float). index.html was never written from scratch; all images resized to max 1000px width before use.
